ns2:course.label: Microbiology
ns2:course.description: Emphasizes fundamental concepts of microbiology, including nutrition, ecology, physiology, genetics and molecular biology of microorganisms, and their role in nature and in infection and immunity. Credit is not given for both MCB 300 and MCB 100. Prerequisite: MCB 250 and credit or concurrent registration in MCB 252 or consent of instructor.
